definition:
flowchart TD
  solo
  subgraph empty1[Deliberately Empty Cluster]
  end
  dup[First label wins?]
  dup[Second label wins?]
  self --> self
  x --> y
  y --> x
  solo --> empty1
intent: Degenerate-case battery in one spec: an isolated single node, an EMPTY subgraph, a duplicate node id declared twice with conflicting labels, a self-referencing edge, a 2-cycle, and an edge pointing AT a cluster id. Probes whether any of these throws, silently drops, or renders a degenerate/collapsed shape.
